# What crates/cli/tests/e2e.rs expects for this scenario. ok/fail: does
# the job run when every job before it passed, or failed. A step `if`
# shows A/B: runs while the job passes / runs after an earlier step failed.

convert: exit 0
validate: exit 0
event push-main (compile refs/heads/main)
  build: not triggered
  ci: triggered
    job build / build on ubuntu-latest: ok=skip fail=skip
      name build
      call build if github.event_name == 'pull_request'
      inputs target=web
      step actions/checkout@v5
      step run: npm ci && npm run build -- --target ${{ inputs.target }}
    job test on ubuntu-latest: ok=run fail=run
      step actions/checkout@v5
      step run: npm ci && npm test
    job deploy-preview on ubuntu-latest after build / build + test: ok=skip fail=skip
      if github.event_name == 'pull_request'
      step deploy
    job e2e on ubuntu-latest after deploy-preview: ok=skip fail=skip
      step run: npx playwright test
event push-feature (compile refs/heads/feature/login)
  build: not triggered
  ci: not triggered
event push-tag (compile refs/tags/v1.4.0)
  build: not triggered
  ci: not triggered
event pull_request-opened (compile refs/heads/main)
  build: not triggered
  ci: triggered
    job build / build on ubuntu-latest: ok=run fail=run
      name build
      call build if github.event_name == 'pull_request'
      inputs target=web
      step actions/checkout@v5
      step run: npm ci && npm run build -- --target ${{ inputs.target }}
    job test on ubuntu-latest: ok=run fail=run
      step actions/checkout@v5
      step run: npm ci && npm test
    job deploy-preview on ubuntu-latest after build / build + test: ok=run fail=skip
      if github.event_name == 'pull_request'
      outputs url=
      step deploy
    job e2e on ubuntu-latest after deploy-preview: ok=run fail=skip
      step run: npx playwright test
event pull_request-synchronize (compile refs/heads/main)
  build: not triggered
  ci: triggered
    job build / build on ubuntu-latest: ok=run fail=run
      name build
      call build if github.event_name == 'pull_request'
      inputs target=web
      step actions/checkout@v5
      step run: npm ci && npm run build -- --target ${{ inputs.target }}
    job test on ubuntu-latest: ok=run fail=run
      step actions/checkout@v5
      step run: npm ci && npm test
    job deploy-preview on ubuntu-latest after build / build + test: ok=run fail=skip
      if github.event_name == 'pull_request'
      outputs url=
      step deploy
    job e2e on ubuntu-latest after deploy-preview: ok=run fail=skip
      step run: npx playwright test
event pull_request-closed (compile refs/heads/main)
  build: not triggered
  ci: not triggered
event workflow_dispatch (compile refs/heads/main)
  build: not triggered
  ci: not triggered
